findings.reason: the retirement still proceeds and the miscount does not change the design, but the node that retires these names must read the arm's own __all__ rather than the plan's list, or it will either miss the SEMANTIC exclusion rationale or over-retire CACHE_ENV/DIGEST_ENV.
findings.text: §7 states the arm "imports them, uses them as dataclass field defaults, and re-exports them in its own __all__", i.e. all three of PINNED_SEMANTIC_IDENTITY, PINNED_PHYSICAL_DIGEST and PINNED_REGISTRY_DIGEST, but the file imports and re-exports only PINNED_PHYSICAL_DIGEST and PINNED_REGISTRY_DIGEST (imports 67-68, __all__ 88-89); PINNED_SEMANTIC_IDENTITY never appears in the file and the module docstring records that it is deliberately excluded so the arm can run on any description revision, while CACHE_ENV and DIGEST_ENV are also re-exported there and are not among the names being retired — so a blanket retirement of the arm's __all__, and the "three public definitions and their re-export" count, are both off by what the file actually carries

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — the two substantive new entries hide real behaviour behind a small interface: cocos_convention's private kernel hides the raw/equilibrium read and coefficient derivation behind a shared computation, and challenge/convention.measure_convention hides the Grad–Shafranov integral, the sign tests and per-corpus eligibility behind one entry, with measure_diiid_convention collapsing to a loader argument.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — the §7 retirement census of the duplicate PINNED_* re-export surface in machine_artifact_arm.py under-enumerates it.
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; every section that adds surface states in its own text what it retires or why nothing can be (e.g. §5 "adds one schema field and retires nothing, because no signal-rule validation state exists"; §6 "retires nothing, because no catalogue-driven observation reader exists" for read_catalogue_observation and "no generic convention entry exists" for measure_convention; §7 retires the three PINNED_* names and their re-export and names the table that replaces them). No section adds surface unaccounted.
rubric_items.reuse_search: pass — the plan names the existing owner for each mechanism it extends and every one I opened exists: gs/operator.py build_operator (805), ForwardOperator.vacuum_prediction (578) and assemble_pf_currents (582); eval/efit_referee.py read_efit_geometry's loader= seam (120-124); machine_map.py's validation vocabulary (_VALIDATION_STATES, line 38) and _SIGN/_VALIDATION pairing (1613); cocos_convention.py score_convention/score_conventions/format_sign_report; eddb_remote.py to extend for EQDB; gs/machine_identity.default_registry (145); spine_bench/shots.py machine field. No mechanism is rebuilt where an owner exists.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — the wrappers the plan keeps are seam adapters it justifies rather than parallel machinery: measure_diiid_convention becomes a call to measure_convention with the DIII-D loader (callers unchanged), and the §7 SELENE reference loader adapts §6's EfitLabels into the EquilibriumGeometry that read_efit_geometry already returns, which the plan states is required so the sign scorer and the geometry referee cannot drift.
